description: Single source of truth for surface and object material properties and the object-surface contact parameters used by the scenarios. Scenes copy the values they use into their ground truth.

Threshold_Tray_Rectangle_Porcelain.mass_note: solid porcelain: the scanned shell is the material itself, so mass = ceramic density x mesh volume

Victor_Reversible_Bookend.mass_note: estimate for a hollow desk organiser with drawers (not measured); effective density = estimated mass / outer mesh volume. Material class chosen as metal; it may be painted wood

Hasbro_Life_Board_Game.mass_note: estimate for the boxed game with contents (not measured); effective density = estimated mass / outer mesh volume

Eat_to_Live_The_Amazing_NutrientRich_Pro.mass_note: estimate for a ~400-page paperback (not measured); effective density = estimated mass / outer mesh volume

Vans_Cereal_Honey_Nut_Crunch_11_oz_box.mass_note: estimate: 11 oz (312 g) of cereal plus carton and liner (not measured); effective density = estimated mass / outer mesh volume
